items.reason: Inclusion requires 'WHO grade IV GBM or its variants' with no IDH requirement anywhere in the record, and allows GBM diagnosed after 'original histology was low-grade glioma' (secondary GBM, IDH-mutant under CNS5). Grade-IV wording without IDH fits C8 'historical'; not an explicit IDH-mutant allowance, hence medium.

note: cns5_terminology affects only sensitivity analysis 10. CD8+ TIL density is a pharmacodynamic endpoint (priority-3 match disagreement), not a selection biomarker, so the primary outcome is unaffected.
